label: Virtual List
description: Windowed rendering for big arrays: a Virtual List visual node keeps only the rows that intersect its viewport (plus an overscan margin) in the DOM, absolutely positioned over a full-height spacer, so a ten-thousand-row array scrolls smoothly where a Repeater stalls. Inputs: Items (array), Row Template ({{field}} text substitution), Item Height (fixed, px), Overscan, Height or Use Container Size. Outputs: First Visible Index, Visible Count. Ships a demo component with 10,000 generated rows.
